description.en: MuScriptor is an audio-to-symbolic model that converts music audio into symbolic note events or MIDI files, with instrument constraints, sampling, beam search, batch chunk decoding, and streaming final-result output.
description.zh: MuScriptor 是音频转符号模型，将音乐音频转换为符号音符事件或 MIDI，支持乐器约束、采样、束搜索、分批分块解码与流式最终结果输出。

instruments.en: Comma-separated instrument group names to constrain generated MIDI events; empty allows all instruments.
instruments.zh: 用于约束生成 MIDI 事件的乐器组名称（逗号分隔）；为空则允许所有乐器。

output_format.en: Primary output serialization written by --out; midi writes a MIDI file, json writes generated note events. Default midi.
output_format.zh: --out 写出的主输出格式；midi 写 MIDI 文件，json 写生成的音符事件。默认 midi。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated MIDI-event token count per chunk; default 2000.
max_tokens.zh: 每个分块最多生成的 MIDI 事件 token 数；默认 2000。

temperature.en: Sampling temperature when do_sample=true; 0 is accepted for compatibility and behaves deterministically, default 1.0.
temperature.zh: do_sample=true 时的采样温度；为兼容性接受 0 并表现为确定性；默认 1.0。

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance coefficient; 1 disables CFG, default 1.0.
guidance_scale.zh: 无分类器引导系数；1 表示关闭 CFG，默认 1.0。

seed.en: Sampling seed; default 0. Parsed as int64 and converted to uint64; negative values wrap.
seed.zh: 种子取样；默认0。解析为int64并转换为uint64；负值换行。

do_sample.en: Use temperature sampling instead of greedy token selection; default false.
do_sample.zh: 使用温度采样而非贪心 token 选择；默认 false。

batch_size.en: Number of audio chunks processed per batch when prelude_forcing=false; default 1.
batch_size.zh: prelude_forcing=false 时每批处理的音频分块数；默认 1。

num_beams.en: Beam-search width; 1 disables beam search, default 1. Beam search requires guidance_scale=1, do_sample=false, and an actual graph batch of one.
num_beams.zh: beam search 宽度；1 关闭 beam search，默认 1。beam search 要求 guidance_scale=1、do_sample=false，且实际图批大小为 1。

prelude_forcing.en: Force open-note prelude tokens between sequential chunks; default true.
prelude_forcing.zh: 在顺序分块之间强制加入 open-note 前奏 token；默认 true。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
